name: kkj_go_jp-mcp
description: Kankojyu Information Portal (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /api/?Query=…&Count=…&CFT_Issue_Date=<60 days ago>/ (XML; guide §3). `query` is required in practice (Query is the one mandatory search string; AND/OR/ANDNOT operators allowed; a single kana character is rejected). Count is the maximum number of results (the API has no offset or page parameter, so page is not sent — ignore next_page); results are limited to notices dated in the last 60 days. posted_at is 公告日 (CftIssueDate), deadline 入札開始日 (TenderSubmissionDeadline, often absent); category (物品/工事/役務), prefecture, OpeningTendersEvent and Attachments are in raw. A malformed query answers <Results><Error>…</Error></Results> with no results (postings is then empty).
